_readme: Robinhood (4663) — DEEPEN the EXISTING seeded WETH/tHOOK v2 pool so the swap UI can quote normal amounts without tripping the price-impact guard. Uses tHOOK by ADDRESS (0x3b5a01Ef.., the already-seeded MockERC20 the deployer already holds ~999.9B of) so addLiquidity ADDS to the existing pair rather than creating a new pool/token. Run: SEED_POOLS=config/robinhood-deepen.json ./scripts/seed.sh robinhood [--broadcast]. FUNDING: the deployer needs ~0.055 ETH on Robinhood (0.05 to wrap into WETH + gas); it already has the tHOOK. Price kept at 1 WETH = 1000 tHOOK (matches the existing pool ratio) so the add is balanced.

4663.label: WETH / tHOOK v2 — deepen existing pool (+0.05 WETH / +50 tHOOK)
